title: Anthony Hobday: the whole site as a monospace ledger with counts
note: One centred column in a monospace font. Name, two one-line 'I design…' statements with inline links, then sections (Paid service, Blog posts, Side projects, Appearances, Books, Case studies, Other projects), each with a count right-aligned in bold and rows with a quantity on the right ('68 clients', '970 words', '1,600+ games'). '[Show 17 more]' expands each list. No images, no motion. Worth reusing: real numbers on the right make it feel authored and honest. It's the opposite of AI-ish because nobody would generate this.
